Open source · Six repositories

Software for
strong-lensing research.

These repositories cover lens simulation, survey-data preparation, machine-learning experiments, and agent-based research workflows.

Repository map

Six repositories across the workflow.

Repository index

Repositories.

Each project addresses a specific part of the research workflow. The summaries below describe what each repository contains and when to use it.

01Core

DeepLense

The central repository for DeepLense datasets, models, benchmarks, and contributor projects on dark-matter structure and strong gravitational lensing.

  • Classification and regression
  • Representation learning
  • Super-resolution
Use it for

Reproducing published experiments, comparing models, and adding new research projects.

Open repository ↗
02Simulation

DeepLenseSim

The simulation code used to generate the early DeepLense datasets with lenstronomy, pyHalo, and Colossus.

  • Lens and source models
  • Dark-matter substructure
  • Dataset generation
Use it for

Generating controlled synthetic datasets and reproducing the group’s early experiments.

Open repository ↗
03Simulation

DeepLense RealSky

A simulation pipeline that combines astronomical source images from GalaxiesML with sampled galaxy and halo parameters.

  • Real galaxy imagery
  • Physical parameter sampling
  • lenstronomy + pyHalo
Use it for

Simulation-to-survey studies that require real source morphology and explicit parameter priors.

Open repository ↗
04Survey data

RIPPLe

The Rubin Image Preparation and Processing Lensing Engine connects Vera C. Rubin Observatory LSST data to DeepLense-ready inputs and model predictions.

  • LSST Butler access
  • Multi-band cutouts
  • Model inference interface
Use it for

Retrieving, normalizing, and analyzing strong-lens candidates from Rubin data products.

Open repository ↗
05Agentic data

RIPPLe Scientist

An experimental agent-based pipeline that separates Rubin data retrieval, deterministic preprocessing, model checks, and scientific decisions through typed interfaces.

  • Rubin DP2 retrieval
  • Typed scientific agents
  • Qualification gates
Use it for

Testing automated survey preparation and model integration with recorded intermediate steps.

Open repository ↗
06Agents

DeepLense AI Scientist

The software accompanying DLens. Pydantic AI agents coordinate simulation, model search, evaluation, and experiment planning through typed tools.

  • Composable agents
  • Structured tool interfaces
  • Local-model support
Use it for

Running and inspecting automated scientific machine-learning experiments.
